_comment: Coordination rules. All distances in millimetres. Edit and save, then run the tools again.

ceiling._comment: Minimum clear height under MEP (bottom of element above the level's floor).

clearance_to_structure_mm._comment: Minimum gap from the TOP of the element to the nearest slab/beam above it. 0 = do not check.

move_set._comment: Move Set (Pipes panel): what moves together with the selected pipe. Angles in degrees, distances in mm.

sections._comment: Place Sections (vision section 4). Distances in mm.
sections._height: From the slab of this level to the slab above, included: bottom = level - below_level_mm, top = top of the slab above (from the linked model at the section) + above_slab_mm.
sections._width: Wall to wall: the line ends past the first room wall (standing on the floor, the networks do not pass over it; any type) or concrete column / beam on each side if it is not farther than max_reach_to_structure_mm from the last network; otherwise it ends margin_no_structure_mm after the networks.
sections._depth: Far clip: depth_default_mm; shorter only before a fragment of a main network in front of the cut: a horizontal main pipe / duct / tray running along the section, visible over more than depth_fragment_min_mm but less than half of the section (a piece after a turn). Fittings, risers, sprinkler heads and mains along the whole section may appear.

main_network._comment: Only main networks are what sections are placed for. Smaller ones are avoided in the cut.

sections._weights: Importance of what a section shows. Sections are chosen one by one, most important first.
sections._spread: Spread over the floor: each chosen section within spread_radius_mm divides the value of one more there by (1 + spread_factor x count).
sections._trim: Width economy: a side ends at a wall crossed inside the section if beyond it there are at most trim_max_networks networks weighing at most trim_max_share of the section.

annotation._comment: Annotate Sections: dimensions and tags of what the section cuts (team rules 2026-11-22).
annotation._sloped: Sloped pipes: tag text turns along the pipe (vertical); leader goes to an elbow down-right, tag just right of it.

concrete._comment: Vertical structure for orientation: concrete walls (by type name), structural columns and beams. Block walls do not count.
